requirements.text: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms and model development.
Familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
Understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation, and statistical concepts.
Experience working with databases, datasets, and data manipulation tools

We are seeking talented and motivated AI/ML Engineers to join our technology team in San Francisco, California. The ideal candidates will have strong programming skills, hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms, and the ability to develop, implement, and optimize AI/ML solutions to address real-world business challenges.
